verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤੁ ਅਜਾਮਲ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਲਾਵਤਣੀ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: patit ajaamal paap kar jai kalaavatanee dhe rahiaa|

en.bdb: Ajamil, the fallen sinner lived with a prostitute.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਹਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur te bemukh hoi kai paap kamaavai dhuramat dhahiaa|

en.bdb: He became an apostate. He was entangled in the cobweb of evil deeds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਵਹਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: birathaa janam gavaiaa bhavajal a(n)dhar firadhaa vahiaa|

en.bdb: His life was wasted in futile deeds and was tossed and thrown within the terrifying worldly ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਪੁਤ ਜਾਏ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਪਾਪਾ ਦੇ ਫਲ ਇਛੇ ਲਹਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhia put jaae vesuaa paapaa dhe fal ichhe lahiaa|

en.bdb: While with the prostitute, he became the father of six sons.  As a result of her bad deeds they all became dangerous robbers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਉਪੰਨਾਂ ਸਤਵਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਣ ਨੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਉਮਹਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: put upa(n)naa(n) satavaa(n) naau dharan no chit umahiaa|

en.bdb: A seventh son was born and he began to consider a name for the child.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਹਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: guroo dhuaarai jai kai gurmukh naau narain kahiaa|

en.bdb: He visited the Guru who named his son Narayan (a name for God).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਕਾਲ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਵੇਖਿ ਪੁਤ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਛਹਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)takaal jamadhoot vekh put narain bolai chhahiaa|

en.bdb: At the end of his life, seeing the messengers of death Ajamil cried for Narayan.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਗਣ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਰਗ ਜਮੁ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਸਹਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: jam gan maare har janaa(n) giaa surag jam dda(n)dd na sahiaa|

en.bdb: The name of God made the death messengers take to their heels. Ajamil went to heaven and did not suffer the beatings from the club of the messengers of death.
Utterance of Name of the Lord dispels all sorrow.
